editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: XTB is a legitimate, publicly listed broker regulated by FCA, KNF Poland, CySEC, FSCA, and DFSA. It scores 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026 — exceptional on platform quality (xStation 5), corporate transparency (WSE listed), and the unique combination of 0% commission real stock investing alongside CFD trading. The $0 minimum deposit removes all barriers to entry. The 80% retail loss rate is concerning. Best for traders who want a modern proprietary platform with real stock investing and don't need ECN-level forex pricing.
